result.summary: Independent review of T4 (R4 Persistence), run1/root1, for product 10fb2745..., contract 161448e6..., identity 4e79fed6.... I found zero unresolved major or critical defects. I read the source and the recorded check evidence, and I ran nothing myself. app.js saves {version:1, todos, filter} to localStorage["todo-app.v1"] on every add, toggle, delete and filter change. On load, normalize() handles JSON that won't parse, wrong types, invalid items, missing or duplicate ids and unknown filters. A storage read that throws falls back to defaults, and a write that throws is swallowed. Salvaged state is written back as valid data. The recorded checks T4-test (desktop), T4-behavior (mobile) and T4-visual (desktop) all ran in real Chromium 153 via Playwright 1.64.1. Their reports carry the same product, contract and identity hashes, exit_code 0 and stable=true. T4-test and T4-behavior each logged 53 assertions with none failed. The T4-visual report shows reload before/after pixel comparisons plus negative controls that were rejected as different. I opened one screenshot (Active filter after reload); it shows the Active filter marked, the two active tasks and "2 items left". R4 is covered. The only gaps are minor and sit in later stages.
